name: Local API And Terminal
summary: Serves aggregate local tracker data, reward redemption, SSE updates, safe terminal HTML with switchable view modes, and the Terminal-owned desktop pet surface.
critical_flows: show or hide one Terminal-owned transparent desktop pet window
serve package-local pet HTML, manifest, and spritesheet resources
known_gaps: CLI command checks exercise tracker process behavior, but no direct HTTP route integration test was found.

evidence.reason: Defines Express routes, reward redemption endpoint, SSE events, terminal HTML route, and removed endpoint responses.
Controls allowed local and configured dashboard origins for API access.
Renders the safe terminal HTML and switchable view modes served at /terminal.
